jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Backend (100% REMOTO)
jobs_results.description:
En Logicalis Spain estamos buscando un perfil de Desarrollador Backend para integrarse en nuestra BU de Data & Analytics ubicada en las oficinas de Madrid o Barcelona. El equipo de Data & Analytics de Logicalis trabaja con clientes nacionales e internacionales, llevando a cabo importantes proyectos de inteligencia artificial y analítica avanzada, estrategia del dato, gobierno, integración y arquitectura, abarcando todo el ciclo de vida del dato.

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS
• Experiencia en Arquitectura de Microservicios (APIs, RestFul, OpenAPI...).
• Java 8, 11.
• Spring (Spring-Boot, Spring-Batch, MVC).
• Maven.
• Junit, Mockito, Wiremock, MockMVC.
• JPA, Oracle, JDBC.
• Experiencia trabajando con Azure Devops.

BENEFICIOS

> Incorporación inmediata a compañía líder del sector IT con un alto grado de expertise en el área de Data & Analytics dónde nos encontramos en pleno proceso de expansión.

> Estabilidad laboral a través de contrato indefinido con amplias oportunidades de desarrollo... profesional y crecimiento en la compañía.

> Modalidad de trabajo 100% remoto.

> Paquete retributivo muy competitivo acorde a la valía del candidato.

> Posibilidad de acogerse a planes de retribución flexible (tarjeta restaurante, tarjeta transporte y tarjeta guardería).

> Seguro médico y GYMPASS.

> Planes de formación adaptados a cada perfil (cursos técnicos, certificaciones oficiales, formación de idiomas...).

> Portal de descuentos especiales para empleados.

> Buen ambiente de trabajo y entorno muy colaborativo

jobs_results.title: Back-End Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte por fin de un proyecto estratégico y motivador?

Mirai: ¿quiénes somos?

Somos una empresa con más de 25 años de andadura que trabaja en exclusiva para los hoteles con el objetivo de llevar a su máximo potencial la venta directa. Ofrecemos tecnología, marketing digital y consultoría en distribución.

Tenemos actualmente oficinas en España, Francia, Portugal, México y USA.

Podríamos decir que “necesitamos una persona proactiva, decidida, meticulosa, curiosa, comunicativa, motivada y comprometida”. Pero creemos que es mejor que lo compruebes por tí mismo: ¿Este podrías ser tú?:
• Te gustan los retos y no tienes miedo a equivocarte.
• Te gusta inventar y poner en marcha proyectos nuevos. Eres dinámico y te gustan los cambios.
• Te gusta irte a casa cada día aprendiendo algo nuevo.
• Eres un jugador de equipo, te gusta celebrar las victorias y ayudar a tus compañeros cuando están en problemas.
• Te cuestionas si para cumplir un objetivo la decisión tomada es la... mejor. Y eres flexible: reaccionas, reconoces tus errores e intentas corregirlos.
• Te comprometes con tus tareas hasta el final, sin abandonarlas cuando se complican.
• Eres detallista, pero sabes priorizar y tienes foco para no perderte en los detalles.
• Eres empático, sabes escuchar y comunicar tienes una actitud de mejora continua, ganas e ilusión.

Y, en concreto, como ingeniero del SW, necesitamos que:
• Analizando varias cuestiones en diferentes lugares y momentos, seas capaz de encontrar un patrón.
• Te guste hacer una pequeña prueba aislada antes de seguir con el siguiente paso o aplicar a producción.
• Muestres interés en mejorar nuestro software/arquitectura/infraestructura aportando ideas o soluciones, sin limitarte a "copiar/pegar" lo que ya existe.
• Pruebes nuevas soluciones tecnológicas, pero si las utilizas en nuestro producto, sea siempre con justificación.
• Consideras que las herramientas, entorno, lenguajes de programación, aplicaciones, metodologías y tecnologías son solo medios para llegar al objetivo, y, por tanto, pueden cambiar de uno a otro.
• Tienes no solo capacidad para buscar una solución teórica, sino también de implementarla.
• Además es necesario que puedas comunicarte en inglés con fluidez.

Si eres así, nos interesa conocerte.

¿Qué harás?

Entre nuestros productos tenemos un motor de reservas online que es referente en la industria, integrado con los Metabuscadores de precios más conocidos del sector (Google, TripAdvisor, Trivago, Kayak, SkyScanner). Desarrollamos APIs para que terceras empresas, colaboradoras de nuestros clientes, puedan consumir nuestros datos de manera rápida y precisa.

También nos integramos con diversas pasarelas de pago con el fin de facilitar al hotel el poder cobrar parcial o totalmente sus reservas en el momento en que sus clientes las realizan.

Las tecnologías que actualmente utilizamos son:
• Java 11, Spring Boot
• PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
• RabbitMQ

Trabajamos con la nube de Amazon y nuestras aplicaciones funcionan sobre Kubernetes. Somos una empresa muy dinámica, como nuestro sector, y nos apoyamos en metodologías ágiles desde hace 15 años.

No queremos vivir del pasado y presente, sino de un futuro prometedor en la industria turística. Hay un recorrido infinito en la utilización de la tecnología en el sector hotelero (Big Data, IoT, nuevos lenguajes más eficientes, bases de datos NoSQL,...) y queremos recorrer ese camino con personas como tú. Como Ingeniero de SW de Mirai, nos ayudarás a conseguirlo.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Posibilidad de trabajar desde cualquiera de las oficinas de Mirai de Albufeira, Benidorm, Barcelona, Gijón, Madrid, Palma de Mallorca o París… o teletrabajar desde cualquier lugar en el mundo.
• Trabajamos en un entorno distendido, dinámico y multidisciplinar, y nos esforzamos porque fluya el talento, ser profesionales y fomentar la responsabilidad individual.
• Puesto estable.
• Horario atractivo (L a J de 08 a 17hs y V de 08 a 15. Jornada intensiva en verano durante 3 meses).
• Conciliación familiar REAL: nuestra empresa, con una plantilla joven, pero de gran experiencia, siempre ha estado muy concienciada con las necesidades de conciliación familiar de sus empleados, facilitando desde hace años el trabajo en remoto y ofreciendo cierta flexibilidad horaria.
• Ambiente de trabajo cercano y familiar.
• Las oficinas, ubicadas en el centro de las ciudades, y todas ellas diáfanas, disponen de todo lo necesario para hacer que tu día sea más agradable.
• Trabajamos para vivir y no al contrario.
• Equipo de trabajo joven y experimentado.
• Participación en proyecto estratégico.
• Remuneración salarial en función de tu valía.

¡TE ESPERAMOS

jobs_results.title: BackEnd Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Your opportunity
At New Relic, we provide our customers real-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to quickly identify, understand and tackle issues, analyze performance and get the most of their software and infrastructure.

We work with data at a scale found at few companies using a diverse tech stack (Go, Java, JavaScript, React, GraphQL, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Kubernetes, many public cloud web services, and more). You will work with some of the best engineers and seek some of the most complex problems in the industry.

If you love to scale and want to contribute to one of the largest and fastest-growing observability platforms in the market, we want to hear from you. We are a fast-growing software company that cares about our product and culture!

What you'll do
• Build, maintain, and scale back-end services and their... support tools.
• Participate in architectural definitions with a high degree of innovation and creativity.
• Creating automation and tooling to make our systems more scalable and easier to deploy.
• Working directly within a multidisciplinary team to help our customers and partners.
• Research new tools and services to understand complex scenarios and to also propose new features.
• Working in an agile environment with a DevOps approach—teams build and maintain their own software, including taking turns with being on-call.

This role requires
• Experience with distributed systems, concurrency, and scaling in a production environment.
• Strong experience in writing software in OOP (Java, GO, Python...) and you are not afraid of adapting, learning, and working with different languages and frameworks.
• Familiarity with asynchronous programming techniques: streams, event-based flows, task queues, message queues.
• Being comfortable in a fast-paced environment focused on delivering production code at a regular cadence using Agile techniques, tools and methodologies.
• Having a collaborative work style that includes colleagues in important decisions and leads to shared code ownership.
• Proficiency in English.

Bonus points if you have
• Contribution to open source projects.
• Understanding the value that build and test automation brings to a development team's efficiency and reliability and are passionate about applying these techniques to your projects.
• Experience in technical mentorship and support for helping level up the skills of colleagues on the team.

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please visit https://newrelic.avature.net/accommodations to submit your request.

We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.

New Relic currently has offices in Germany, Ireland, Spain, and the United Kingdom, and based on business needs may approve work in Belgium, France, Italy, The Netherlands, Switzerland, UAE, and other locations throughout the region. Some of our opportunities are limited to specific hiring locations. Talk with your recruiter about your goals.

Our hiring process

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers’ means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.

New Relic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We foster a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment, free from all types of discrimination, so our Relics can thrive. We hire people with different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics.

Review our Applicant Privacy Notice at https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy

jobs_results.title: Back End (Java) Engineer
jobs_results.description:
- Remote Spain based -

Our Technology

Our Technology Team is made up of many small multi-discipline, cross-functional, autonomous teams, organised into business domains implementing highly independent self-contained systems. We build sophisticated solutions to solve highly complex business problems; we do so whilst simultaneously transforming our platform and supporting a business at scale. We use a wide range of technologies and cloud services to power our proprietary platform, and we seek simplicity by using the best tools available for the job. We value ownership, collaboration and encourage our people to work across boundaries. We embrace change, we grow, mature, take on new ideas whilst holding onto what is important to us.

What you will do:
• Plan, develop and improve the gambling platform with a very high degree of ownership (“you built it, you run it”) on a continuous delivery basis
• Design and implement interfaces to other high availability systems
• Collaborate closely... with software architects, product owners and stakeholders
• Be part of a highly collaborative agile process
• Use your experience and knowledge to support and make architectural decisions together with the software architects, play a part in the selection of new technologies, and promote knowledge transfer both within your team and between teams

Who you are:
• Experienced with OOP, design patterns, Java 11+ (CDI, JSF, EJB, JAX-RS), databases (NoSQL) and data structures
• Have excellent understanding of complex software architecture
• Familiar with cloud technologies like Kubernetes, Docker
• Experienced with tools such as IntelliJ IDEA, Git, Maven
• Highly familiar with agile development and continuous delivery
• Ensure high quality standards. Awareness of Clean code practices, as well as others (SOLID, KISS, DRY, etc.)

What's in it for you:
• A dynamic and highly motivated international team of skilled and experienced professionals
• An open culture defined by passion for developing software, fun and mutual respect.
• State of the Art technology environment and Continuous Delivery process
• Continuous learning based on a training & development program

Benefits:
• Private Healthcare
• 25 days per annum of annual leave, plus 14 bank holidays – that can be taken at any time during the year subject to management approval.
• Remote work allowance (equal to 50 EUR/ gross monthly)
• Educational opportunities
• Well-being support

Come as you are. And develop yourself.

We are a team of over 45 nations and many talents. Together we create a truly authentic and resilient workplace where everyone can be themselves.

We are an inclusive company. We value diverse approaches and multiple points of view. Diversity creates better ideas. That's why we build a culture where differences are valued.

Here everyone is welcome, regardless of who they are and where they come from. So that opportunities can grow for everyone

jobs_results.title: PROGRAMADOR BACKEND - FULLSTACK - Madrid
jobs_results.description:
¿Te apasiona la informática y ya tienes experiencia en desarrollo? 💻

Puede que esta sea tu oportunidad de comenzar una carrera profesional en ASG -SI del Grupo Tier1 que está ubicada en Madrid

¡Únete a nuestro equipo como Programador/a Oracle especializado en PL/SQL y Java!

🚀En ASG del Grupo Tier1 podrás vivir muchas experiencias y hacer parte de un equipo profesional cohesionado que siempre estarán dispuesto ayudarte y no pararas de aprender y seguir creciendo profesionalmente.

Estarás en rodeado/a de personas motivadas en un ambiente muy bueno donde el equipo te echará una mano siempre que necesites.

Si tienes al menos dos años de experiencia trabajando con PL/SQL y bases de datos Oracle, así como también en Java y Spring Boot, ⌨️

¡queremos conocerte!🔍

✍🏼 ¿Qué buscamos?
• Experiencia mínima de dos años con PL/SQL y base de datos Oracle, incluyendo trabajo con vistas complejas, JSON, XML, procedimientos, tablas temporales, entre otros.
• Experiencia sólida en Java y Spring... Boot, con conocimiento en frameworks como Spring Core, Security, Spring JPA Hibernate, JPA, Batch, Log4j/SLF4J.
• Dominio de Java 8, 11 y 17.
• Experiencia en el manejo de repositorios de código GIT.
• Conocimientos en servicios REST/SOAP.
• Experiencia en la documentación de API's con OpenAPI/Swagger.

📌¿Qué valoramos?
• Conocimientos en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web con Angular 2.
• Familiaridad con el desarrollo y lanzamiento de aplicaciones Android e IOS mediante tecnologías híbridas como IONIC y Flutter.
• Experiencia en el uso de Jira.

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

MultiSafepay is a cutting-edge fintech company that has been revolutionizing the payment industry for over two decades. As a leading Payment Service Provider, we specialize in developing innovative in-house solutions for a diverse range of merchants. Recognized as the top-ranked company in the "Emerce 100" Payment Service Provider category, we provide seamless and secure payment experiences for our clients. Join our dynamic team at our international office in beautiful Estepona, Málaga, and be a part of our journey towards global success.

About the Role: As a Perl Developer at MultiSafepay, you will play a crucial role in our Development team and collaborating with the Operations team, Business Analysts, and Product Managers. You will be responsible for handling risk, monitoring systems, and onboarding processes. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled Perl developer to work on challenging projects, contribute to the migration of projects, and make a... significant impact on our fintech solutions.

Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain Perl-based applications and systems to handle risk management, monitoring, and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with other developers, and cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features and functionalities.
• Assist in the migration of projects from Perl to other languages, such as Java, while ensuring the smooth operation and transition of systems.
• Contribute to code reviews and provide valuable insights to uphold coding standards and best practices.
• Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to drive innovation and enhance our products.

Job requirements
• Proven work experience as a Perl Developer, with a deep understanding of Perl programming language.
• Familiarity with risk management, monitoring systems, and onboarding processes is a plus.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Business Analysts, and Product Managers.
• Experience with migration projects is highly desired.
• Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies, including Java, if required.

At MultiSafepay, we are a team of passionate professionals who strive for excellence. We value a collaborative and inclusive working environment, where every team member's input is respected and appreciated. Our culture is characterized by innovation, teamwork. We believe in continuous learning and offer opportunities for professional growth, along with a competitive salary package and health insurance benefits. Located near the beautiful beach of El Saladillo, our modern office provides a dynamic atmosphere with opportunities for cross-training and extra-office activities like gym access and free Spanish classes.

Ready to Join? If you are a Perl developer who thrives on exciting challenges and wants to make a significant impact in the fintech industry, MultiSafepay is the place for you. Don't worry if you're open to exploring Java or other languages, we're here to support your professional growth. So whether you're a Perl expert or a Java enthusiast willing to dive into the world of Perl, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable member of our team. Help us shape the future of international payment solutions and grow both personally and professionally

jobs_results.title: Backend Software Engineer (Java)
jobs_results.description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, more freedom. And since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. With an arsenal of awesome products that span spending, saving, travel, transfers, investing, exchanging and more, we've helped 40+ million customers get more from their money. And we're not done yet.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, two things are essential to continuing our success: our people and our culture. We've been officially certified as a Great Place to Work™ in recognition of our outstanding employee experience! So far, we have 8,000+ people working around the world, from our great offices or remotely, on our mission. And we're looking for more. We want brilliant people that love building great products, love redefining success, and love turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Our Technology team isn’t just one of the best in the... industry, it’s one of the best in the world. And we’re proud of it. It’s our driving force; our engine 🚀 From building a new banking backend to creating an award-winning app, there’s nothing (and we mean nothing) our tech team can’t do. Our Technology team isn’t here to fix legacy systems – it’s here to build world-class financial products from the ground up. Products that will be used by millions of people around the world 🌎

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer that wants to change the world. If you like to work at a steady pace with no surprises, keep scrolling. If you want your work to change the global financial landscape, you might be just who we’re looking for. We have a minimalist approach to using external frameworks, with emphasis on maintainability and fast turnaround with TDD, DDD, and Continuous Integration & Delivery.

Our technology stack:
• Java 17
• GCP
• Kubernetes
• Docker
• PostgreSQL
• Redis
• Spock
• SparkJava
• JOOQ and TDD approach

Sound like your speed? Let’s chat 👇

What You’ll Be Doing
• Building mobile APIs
• Developing micro services to evolve our architecture
• Perfecting a number of systems that our business depends on, like risk management, fraud detection, and payment processing
• Focusing mostly on greenfield development and improvement of existing systems

What You'll Need
• Fluency with Java
• 6+ years of experience in back-end development
• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Maths, Physics, or similar
• To be a quick learner with an ambitious attitude and results-driven personality
• The ability to work well as part of a team in a fast-paced environment
• Excellent communication and organisational skills
• Fluency in English

Nice to have
• Experience with Kotlin and Scala
• Experience within Finance
• Experience in a start-up or scale-up
• Experience in a product-focused environment

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Refer to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates: https://www.revolut.com/legal/data-privacy-for-candidates for details on our data handling practices during your application

jobs_results.title: Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
About The Company

Ingram Micro touches 80% of the technology you use every day with our focus on Technology Solutions, Cloud, and Commerce and Lifecycle Solutions. With $50 billion in revenue, we have become the world’s largest technology distributor with operations in 64 countries and more than 35,000 associates.

And we are looking for people to build and drive the CloudBlue Monetization Platform. CloudBlue enables companies to succeed in today’s subscription economy by unlocking the power of digital ecosystems and marketplaces. With its pioneering technology, CloudBlue powers the world’s largest cloud B2B marketplaces, and is an industry leader for monetizing B2B cloud subscriptions.

These are our core values:
• Customer Focused
• Our Creative Engine
• Our Trust in the Team
• Our Strive for Excellence
• And Our Passion and Energy

About The Role

We are looking for a Backend Engineer responsible for the development of the Connect platform within the CloudBlue solution. Connect is... a micro-service SaaS platform operating in the Cloud infrastructure which has API interaction, relational and non-relational databases, message broker exchanges, etc.

We are a growing distributed team primarily located in Barcelona with people in Sofia and Irvine CA. We are a diverse group of young and energetic engineers building the cutting-edge tech platform. So if you are looking for the creativity and freedom of a start-up with the stability of a large and established company, let’s get in touch!

What You’ll Be Doing
• Primarily building API and services in Python
• Developing and supporting features from design to production
• Closely working with frontend engineers in small feature teams
• Collaborating with other CloudBlue teams
• Applying tech proposals and enhancements
• Working with your team and engineering manager to grow your career

What You Need
• 3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer
• Experience in Python with 2+ years of experience
• API development and integration expert
• Moderate PostgreSQL and RDBMS knowledge
• Familiar with Docker & Docker Compose
• Basic understanding of the modern frontend tech
• Unit test expert
• Professional working proficiency in English language

Nice To Have
• Django/DRF & FastAPI experience
• Experience with k8s
• Cloud experience with AWS, Azure or GCP
• Experience with IaC, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting
• Open source contribution or a pet project

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
INTRO

El panorama digital sigue evolucionando a un ritmo vertiginoso y aquí en el Tablao Cordobés, una empresa consolidada y líder en el sector turístico en pleno proceso de transformación, tratamos de mantenernos a la vanguardia.

Buscamos un desarrollador back-end para unirse a nuestro equipo digital con modelo de trabajo part-time o autónomo/freelance.

El candidato ideal tendrá una combinación única de conocimientos técnicos, curiosidad insaciable y mentalidad analítica. Esta persona debe sentirse cómoda trabajando tanto de forma independiente como en equipo ya que se comunicará con el equipo de diseño y realizará funciones de desarrollo de sitios web de misión crítica, aplicaciones y capas de infraestructura. Experiencia con Amazon Web Services (AWS), Git y NodeJS es útil para tener éxito rápidamente en este papel.

TAREAS A EJECUTAR:
• Comunicarse regularmente con los equipos relacionados al proyecto, jefes de proyecto, los equipos de control de calidad, diseñadores...
•... Mantener y actualizar bases de datos y servidores
• Optimizar los componentes para el mejor rendimiento en una amplia gama de dispositivos y navegadores.
• Resolver problemas técnicos y desarrollar nuevos conceptos de diseño
• Trabajar en colaboración con el Director Digital, diseñadores web y administradores de proyectos.
• Escritura de aplicaciones web priorizando su seguridad.
• Diseñar y mantener API sólidas para dar soporte a clientes móviles y desktop.

PERFIL BUSCADO:
• Persona proactiva, organizada y autónoma
• Conocimientos y experiencia mínima de 4 años en al menos la mayoría de:
• React -Typescript
• NodeJs
• AWS (Lambdas obligatorio)
• Wordpress
• PHP
• MYSQL
• Storyblok CMS (optional)
• Conocimientos de herramientas de Project Management (Notion)
• Buen nivel de inglés y valorable otros idiomas

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
ABOUT STRANDS

Strands is a leading fintech company at the forefront of innovation in the financial industry. Our cutting-edge solutions empower banks and financial institutions to deliver personalized and intelligent banking experiences. Our products are fully embedded with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning capabilities so joining us is a great opportunity to be at the forefront of this new revolution.

With more than 100 employees worldwide we still work as a startup. Since 2020 we are part of the CRIF group, a world leader in the Financial Sector. So we have the best of both worlds, we operate as a startup and we are backed by a big company!

ABOUT THE ROLE

Love the smell of fresh code in the morning? Are you a passionate developer and a need to be challenged? Do you want to be part of a team that develops innovative and lasting product?

Strands is waiting for you! You will join our Engineering Team and help design and develop an innovative FinTech software that... enables banks to offer personalised digital banking experiences.

Reporting to the Backend Technical Lead, the candidate will work on the development of sophisticated and innovative backend solutions in a fast-paced, dynamic and international team.

You will do things like...
• Design the architecture of our platform with our Backend Architect
• Programming highly-available software and innovative functionality
• Work with Kafka and other messaging systems
• Analyse requirements and solutions to provide the best software experience.
• Troubleshooting and issue resolution.
• Understanding of Java server-side technologies.

You'll do it using your...
• Compelling working experience in a Java 8/JEE/Kotlin/Scala back-end environment (preferably using Agile / Scrum methodology)
• Excellent knowledge of SOLID principles and design patterns
• Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and why they are important
• Build reliable, highly available, and scalable software on top of streaming platforms like Kafka/ AMQP / Google Pub/Sub technologies.
• Developing REST-based APIs.
• Experience in SQL/NoSQL technologies

You'll love it because you will get...
• Competitive salary;
• Private health care insurance;
• Gym free pass;
• Meal vouchers;
• Subscription to unlimited online training courses by Udemy;
• Flexible working hours;
• Snacks and food, Fresh organic fruit, drinks, tea, coffee and juices;
• Cutting-edge technologies;
• Hybrid model of working from home and office attendance.

Don’t hesitate to apply even if you are not sure to cover all requirements, we would love to see your profile
